attchmntText: Mahindra & Mahindra Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript of M&M Analyst Meet Q2F27
voiceSummary: Mahindra and Mahindra submitted the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call held on 5th November 2026. Consolidated revenue rose 25% to Rs. 57,553 crores, with profit after tax increasing 25% to Rs. 4,588 crores. Return on equity stood at 21%. Auto business profit grew 55%, while Farm sector profit declined 9%. Mahindra Finance profit increased 61%, and Tech M profit rose 33%. Logistics showed a significant turnaround, and Accelo profit grew 70%. The company maintained its long-term targets of 15% to 20% EPS growth and 18% RoE. Management highlighted resilience against commodity inflation and geopolitical challenges. No unpublished price sensitive information was shared during the meet. The transcript is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Mahindra & Mahindra Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Mahindra & Mahindra Limited has intimated the schedule of analyst and institutional investor meetings under SEBI regulations. The company will participate in the 29th CITIC CLSA India Forum on 16th November 2026 in Mumbai from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. IST. The Avendus Spark Annual Investor Conference is also scheduled for 16th November 2026 in Mumbai from 10:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. IST. On 17th November 2026, the company will attend the 29th CITIC CLSA India Forum keynote in Mumbai from 10:00 a.m. to 11:00 a.m. IST and the JM Financial Annual India Conference in Mumbai from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. IST. The Morgan Stanley 25th Annual Asia Pacific Summit will take place on 18th November 2026 in Singapore from 9:30 a.m. to 4:20 p.m. SST. The company confirmed that no unpublished price sensitive information will be shared during these events.
